name: Dart Monkey
summary: Cheapest Primary tower and a common CHIMPS opener. Crossbow Master is its late-game carry; Apex Plasma Master is a cheap Paragon option against tier 3–4 bosses.

routes.name: Crossbow Master
routes.note: Camo detection from the bottom path and strong on straight track sections. The wiki gives no specific crosspath, so 0-2-5 is the common default. v57: now fires two parallel bolts at half the attack rate; Crossbow and Sharp Shooter tiers gained pierce and crit damage.

routes.name: Plasma Monkey Fan Club
routes.note: Ability turns nearby Dart Monkeys into plasma-firing Super Monkeys for a burst window.

routes.name: Ultra-Juggernaut
routes.note: Strong against Ceramic, Fortified and Lead bloons; best near walls it can bounce off.

chimps: Cheapest Primary and a standard CHIMPS opener (Dart + Ninja, Dart + Desperado or Dart + Sub starts).
Crossbow Master needs camo from its own bottom path; place it along straight track sections.
boss: Apex Plasma Master is the cheapest Paragon and a good option against tier 3–4 bosses.

synergies.note: Ninja + Dart start handles about half of Advanced maps.
Two-tower CHIMPS start.
Brews multiply a Crossbow Master's pierce.

name: Boomerang Monkey
summary: Glaive Lord is a CHIMPS win condition and MOAB Press is a standard support pick for knocking blimps back.

routes.name: Glaive Lord
routes.note: CHIMPS win condition. Switch to 5-2-0 when you need lead-popping or MIB-style coverage.

routes.name: MOAB Press
routes.note: Support: knocks MOAB-class back and helps with the Super Ceramic insides on R98/R99.

routes.name: Early CHIMPS build
routes.note: The wiki's recommended early-game Boomerang for CHIMPS (1-0-2 for early boss events).

chimps: Early CHIMPS: 0-2-2.
Glaive Lord (5-0-2) is a win condition; switch to 5-2-0 when you need lead popping.
MOAB Press (2-0-4) knocks blimps back and helps on R98/R99.
boss: Early boss events: 1-0-2.
Glaive Dominus is a Lych-capable Paragon at higher degrees.

synergies.note: Berserker Brew on many-projectile towers.
Jungle Drums attack speed.

name: Bomb Shooter
summary: MOAB Mauler is a popular answer to the first MOAB (R40). MOAB Eliminator and Assassin are strong boss options, and Bomb Blitz is a CHIMPS win condition. v57 nerfed Bomb Blitz (one passive trigger per round) and changed MOAB Assassin frags (more pierce, half as many).

routes.name: MOAB Mauler
routes.note: Listed as an R40 answer in CHIMPS and described as a popular current pick.

routes.name: MOAB Eliminator
routes.note: Strong against Lych, but save the ability for when it reaches a skull and never fire it at Lych itself.

routes.name: Sticky Bomb
routes.note: Boss damage against Bloonarius; Blastapopoulos burns damage-over-time off, so avoid it there.

routes.name: Bomb Blitz
routes.note: Named as a CHIMPS win condition on the wiki (v55.1), but v57 limits its passive to one trigger per round, so treat it as weaker until the wiki re-evaluates it.

chimps: MOAB Mauler (2-3-0) is a standard R40 answer.
Bomb Blitz was a listed win condition, but v57 limits its passive to once per round.
boss: MOAB Eliminator against Lych: attack normally, save the ability until a skull.
Sticky Bomb damage gets burned off by Blastapopoulos.

synergies.note: Buffs explosive towers and black-bloon popping.

name: Tack Shooter
summary: Short range, but many projectiles make it a great target for flat damage and pierce buffs. Bottom-path Overdrive and Tack Zone show up in several boss strategies.

routes.name: Overdrive
routes.note: Bottom path wants the top-path attack-speed crosspath. Used against Bloonarius and Lych (needs support in Dreadbloon's lead phase).

routes.name: The Tack Zone
routes.note: Recommended against Lych and Dreadbloon when placed to kill spawns quickly.

routes.name: Ring of Fire
routes.note: Spawn defense against Bloonarius; benefits from covering as much track as possible.

chimps: Short range: place it on corners and tight curves.
Bottom path wants the top-path attack speed crosspath (2-0-4 / 2-0-5).
boss: Overdrive and The Tack Zone appear in Bloonarius, Lych and Dreadbloon strategies.
Ring of Fire (4-2-0) handles Bloonarius spawns.
Crucible of Steel and Flame is a cheap Paragon that does well against Diamondback.

synergies.note: Berserker Brew's flat damage and pierce suit its many tacks.
Embrittlement adds damage to every tack.

name: Ice Monkey
summary: Embrittlement makes hit bloons take extra damage while frozen and temporarily lose Lead immunity. The wiki calls 5-2-0 the best all-round late pick; Ice towers also keep Blastapopoulos's heat down. v57: freeze now applies after damage.

routes.name: Embrittlement → 5-2-0 Super Brittle
routes.note: Best all-round damage and support line. Super Brittle is a staple debuff in boss strategies (Lych, Phayze).

routes.name: Icicle Impale
routes.note: Highest raw damage except against BADs. Handles DDTs if something else gives camo detection.

routes.name: Absolute Zero
routes.note: Pure support: can slow or freeze up to 300 bloons for your other towers.

chimps: Embrittlement lets your other towers pop leads and adds damage to frozen bloons.
0-2-5 with camo from a 0-2-0 Village can handle DDTs alone.
boss: Super Brittle is a staple boss debuff (Lych, Phayze).
Ice attacks cool Blastapopoulos, and Ice Monkeys ignore its overheat.

synergies.note: Range, Ice Fragments and tier-5 discounts for Ice Monkeys.
Many-projectile towers gain the most from Embrittlement.

name: Glue Gunner
summary: The Bloon Solver is a CHIMPS win condition against late Ceramics. Glue Strike and Glue Storm let other towers hurt lead bloons such as DDTs, and the bottom path's slows are valuable in almost any late game.

routes.name: The Bloon Solver
routes.note: CHIMPS win condition, often paired with Carpet of Spikes. Also handles the Super Ceramic insides on R98.

routes.name: Glue Strike
routes.note: Mid-game support (1-4-0 late). Glued targets take extra damage from other towers. v57: Glue Strike costs more ($4,000 → $4,500) and Glue Splatter less ($970 → $650).

routes.name: Super Glue
routes.note: Late-game stall against blimps; recommended as support against Lych.

chimps: The Bloon Solver (5-2-0) is a win condition against late Ceramics and R98's insides.
Glue Strike (2-4-0 mid, 1-4-0 late) lets other towers hurt DDTs.
boss: Super Glue and Glue Storm are support picks against Lych.
Slows hold back a bloon's children too, so cheap glue stalls well on spaced rounds.

synergies.note: Relentless Glue triggers her stun and slow bonus.
Glue Storm is part of the Comanche Commander win condition.
Carpet of Spikes pairs with The Bloon Solver.

name: Desperado
summary: Primary gunslinger added in v49. Strong early with long range and perfect targeting; two Desperados, or Dart + Desperado, are viable CHIMPS starts.

routes.name: The Blazing Sun
routes.note: Highest single-target damage on the top path; a cheap option for tier 1 bosses such as Bloonarius.

routes.name: Golden Justice
routes.note: Very high damage with infinite pierce but slow; needs cleanup support. Listed as a Lych support pick.

routes.name: The Desert Phantom
routes.note: Crowd control and group damage with knockback; weak against single targets and DDTs.

chimps: Two Desperados, or Dart + Desperado, are viable CHIMPS starts thanks to range and targeting.
Golden Justice and the bottom path need cleanup support.
boss: The Blazing Sun is a cheap tier 1 boss option; Bounty Hunter marking boosts damage on blimps.

synergies.note: A base Desperado spots for Advanced Intel Subs.
Two-tower CHIMPS start.

name: Sniper Monkey
summary: Global range. Elite Defender can clear Lych and its spawns alone and has native camo detection for Phayze; Cripple MOAB is a key blimp debuff in boss strategies. v57 added its Paragon, the S.P.I.D.E.R. Monkey, and Supply Drop can now switch to an Ammo Drop.

routes.name: Elite Defender
routes.note: Boss staple: solos Lych if kept away from it, works against Phayze and Bloonarius.

routes.name: Cripple MOAB
routes.note: MOAB-class stun plus a damage debuff that helps the rest of your defense (Lych, Phayze).

routes.name: Maim MOAB
routes.note: Cheaper blimp stun for CHIMPS (Cheaper Maiming MK cuts $1,000). The wiki doesn't confirm whether BADs ignore it.

chimps: Global range: anywhere on the map works.
Maim MOAB stuns blimps; the Cheaper Maiming MK cuts its cost by $1,000.
boss: Elite Defender (2-0-5) can solo Lych from far away and has camo for Phayze.
Cripple MOAB (5-0-2) is a key blimp debuff.
v57 added the S.P.I.D.E.R. Monkey Paragon.

synergies.note: Cripple MOAB amplifies Ninja damage on blimps.
Permanent Brew suits Full Auto Rifles.

name: Monkey Sub
summary: Submerge and Support (top tier 3) is a consistent decamo tool. The wiki says Sub Commander struggles late in CHIMPS against Super Ceramics, while Energizer is a common late pick with Brickell and Psi.

routes.name: Advanced Intel + Airburst Darts
routes.note: Standard early build; upgrade the top path to Submerge and Support (3-0-2) for decamo.

routes.name: Energizer
routes.note: Common late-game pick with Admiral Brickell or Psi.

routes.name: Sub Commander
routes.note: Strong in boss events (Dreadbloon, Lych with Triple Guns or Brickell, Phayze with Armor Piercing Darts).

routes.name: First Strike Capability
routes.note: Ability can skip a damaged BAD's insides; Pre-emptive Strike (x-5-x) pairs with Silas.

chimps: Standard early build 2-0-2; add Submerge and Support (3-0-2) for decamo.
Sub Commander struggles late against Super Ceramics; Energizer is the late pick.
boss: Sub Commander (2-0-5) works against Dreadbloon, Lych and Phayze.
First Strike can skip a damaged BAD's insides.

synergies.note: Naval buffs; Energizer and Sub Commander pairings.
Energizer helps Psi level.
Pre-emptive Strike covers DDTs and the BAD with Silas.

name: Monkey Buccaneer
summary: Water only. Carrier Flagship and Pirate Lord are CHIMPS win conditions with Admiral Brickell. Merchantmen are an income option for boss events but are to be avoided in CHIMPS.

routes.name: Carrier Flagship
routes.note: CHIMPS win condition with Brickell; use 5-0-2 if you don't need the Destroyer attack.

routes.name: Pirate Lord
routes.note: CHIMPS win condition with Brickell; clears blimp-heavy late rounds.

routes.name: Destroyer
routes.note: Support DPS; Grape Shot helps with early MOABs. Destroyer spam with Brickell works against Dreadbloon and Phayze.

routes.name: Merchantman
routes.note: Boss-event income on water maps; scales with Central Markets and Trade Empire. Useless in CHIMPS.

chimps: Water only. Carrier Flagship and Pirate Lord are win conditions with Brickell.
Merchantman and its upgrades earn nothing in CHIMPS.
boss: Merchantmen + Central Markets + Trade Empire replace Banana Farms on water maps.
Destroyer spam with Brickell works against Dreadbloon and Phayze.
Navarch of the Seas is a strong Paragon (save about $980,000 for a 40-Merchantman setup).

synergies.note: Buffs every water tower.
Central Markets add +10% Merchantman income each.

name: Monkey Ace
summary: Sky Shredder is a CHIMPS win condition (with Stronger Stimulant). Flying Fortress does heavy boss damage on any map.

routes.name: Sky Shredder
routes.note: High MOAB-class damage; benefits from Stronger Stimulant.

routes.name: Flying Fortress
routes.note: Strong late-game boss damage on all map formats.

routes.name: Spectre
routes.note: Easy to use, but the wiki notes it isn't cost-efficient.

chimps: Sky Shredder (5-2-0) is a win condition; it benefits from Stronger Stimulant.
Ignores blockers, so it works on any map.
boss: Flying Fortress (2-0-5) is strong late boss damage on any map format.
Goliath Doomship is one of the highest-damage Paragons.

synergies.note: Stronger Stimulant boosts Sky Shredder.
Discounts Aces in her range.

name: Heli Pilot
summary: Comanche Commander is a CHIMPS win condition paired with Geraldo and Glue Storm. The 0-1-3 MOAB Shove build is one of the best support options.

routes.name: Comanche Commander
routes.note: CHIMPS win condition with Geraldo and Glue Storm.

routes.name: MOAB Shove
routes.note: Support build: Bigger Jets amplifies the shove on MOAB-class.

routes.name: Special Poperations
routes.note: Its ability helps keep lives up against Lych's soul.

chimps: Comanche Commander (2-0-5) is a win condition with Geraldo and Glue Storm.
0-1-3 MOAB Shove is one of the best support builds.
boss: Special Poperations helps keep lives up against Lych.
Support Chinook can carry towers out of Vortex's stun range.

synergies.note: Part of the Comanche Commander win condition.
Glue Storm completes the same combo.
Discounts Heli Pilots in her range.

name: Mortar Monkey
summary: Pop and Awe is a CHIMPS win condition with Striker Jones, stuns and Perma-Spike. Blooncineration is recommended as a late CHIMPS carry for its damage over time.

routes.name: Pop and Awe
routes.note: Outstanding grouped damage below BAD; pairs with Striker Jones. The wiki gives no specific crosspath.

routes.name: Blooncineration
routes.note: Late-game CHIMPS carry thanks to strong damage over time.

routes.name: Artillery Battery
routes.note: Mid-game carry; Shattering Shells (x-x-4) helps on Fortified-heavy rounds.

chimps: Pop and Awe is a win condition with Striker, stuns and Perma-Spike.
Blooncineration is a late CHIMPS carry; Shattering Shells helps on Fortified rounds.
Reposition the reticle ahead of bloons, ideally on bends.
boss: Top-path upgrades have black-bloon weaknesses: bring Striker's buff.

synergies.note: Favoured hero: attack speed and black popping.
Perma-Spike covers Pop and Awe's leaks.

name: Dartling Gunner
summary: Bloon Exclusion Zone is a CHIMPS win condition, reached through BADS as a mid-game save-up. Ray of Doom, Plasma Accelerator and M.A.D appear in boss strategies.

routes.name: Bloon Exclusion Zone
routes.note: CHIMPS win condition.

routes.name: Bloon Area Denial System
routes.note: Mid-game save-up tower on the way to BEZ.

routes.name: Ray of Doom
routes.note: Boss damage (Dreadbloon); Plasma Accelerator (4-2-0) works against Bloonarius and Phayze.

routes.name: M.A.D
routes.note: Strong single-tower option against Lych and Bloonarius.

chimps: Bloon Exclusion Zone (2-0-5) is a win condition; BADS (2-0-4) is the save-up step.
Infinite range and aimable: strongest on open maps.
boss: Ray of Doom and Plasma Accelerator for boss damage; M.A.D against Lych and Bloonarius.

synergies.note: Brews on Hydra Rocket Pods.

name: Wizard Monkey
summary: Archmage does well on many Expert CHIMPS maps with long-range seeking damage that ignores walls. It excels on DDT rounds but lacks pierce for dense rounds and is weak against Super Ceramics.

routes.name: Archmage
routes.note: Best for single targets and clumped blimps; aim Wall of Fire onto blimps. Needs camo from another tower. 5-0-2 trades DPS for innate camo (good against Phayze).

routes.name: Wall of Fire
routes.note: Cheap CHIMPS support listed on the wiki's CHIMPS page.

routes.name: Wizard Lord Phoenix
routes.note: Boss option against Dreadbloon from tier 2; Arcane Spike (4-2-0) for tier 1.

chimps: Archmage (5-2-0) does well on many Expert maps and excels on DDT rounds, but needs camo support and struggles with Super Ceramics.
Wall of Fire (1-2-0) is cheap CHIMPS support.
boss: Wizard Lord Phoenix and Archmage against Dreadbloon.
Magus Perfectus is one of the highest-damage Paragons (weak against Blastapopoulos).

synergies.note: The Bloon Solver cleans up behind an Archmage.
Dragon's Breath triggers her damage-over-time bonus.

name: Super Monkey
summary: The CHIMPS strategy page doesn't list a Super Monkey win condition, but boss strategies use Sun Avatar, Sun Temple and Legend of the Night. Needs Ultravision (bottom tier 2) or support for camo.

routes.name: Sun Avatar
routes.note: Boss pick against Dreadbloon; gets big value from Berserker or Permanent Brew.

routes.name: Sun Avatar (Ultravision)
routes.note: Trades range for camo detection and knockback.

routes.name: Sun Temple
routes.note: Late boss damage; the wiki's boss guide powers it with $45,000+ of sacrifices.

routes.name: Legend of the Night
routes.note: Tier 3+ boss option against Bloonarius.

chimps: Not listed as a CHIMPS win condition on the wiki; needs Ultravision or support for camo.
boss: Sun Avatar (3-2-0), Sun Temple (4-2-0) and Legend of the Night (2-0-5) appear in boss strategies.
Sun Temple needs $45,000+ of support sacrifices.

synergies.note: Permanent Brew is the only way to fully buff a Sun Avatar.
Energizer supports Super Monkeys.

name: Ninja Monkey
summary: The camo specialist. Bloon Sabotage's global slowdown is its main pick outside Ninja-focused builds and is especially strong against DDTs. Top and middle Ninjas shine against bosses.

routes.name: Bloon Sabotage
routes.note: Global slow, strongest against DDTs; recommended for R99 in CHIMPS. Shinobi Tactics (0-3-0) buffs other Ninjas.

routes.name: Grandmaster Ninja
routes.note: Boss damage (Dreadbloon); scales with Permanent Brew and Cripple MOAB.

routes.name: Sticky Bomb
routes.note: Burst damage against Bloonarius; burned off by Blastapopoulos.

chimps: Native camo detection; Shinobi Tactics (0-3-0) stacks buffs on Ninja-heavy builds.
Bloon Sabotage (0-4-0) is the R99 pick and strongest against DDTs.
boss: Grandmaster Ninja (5-0-2) against Dreadbloon; top and middle Ninjas shine against bosses.
Ascended Shadow is a strong Paragon against Phayze and Vortex.

synergies.note: Permanent Brew boosts damage and pierce.
Cripple MOAB amplifies blimp damage.
Dart + Ninja start.

name: Alchemist
summary: Its top path is the most useful because of the buffs. Brews give the biggest gains to many-projectile towers such as Bloonjitsu or Overdrive. Avoid Rubber to Gold and Bloon Master Alchemist in CHIMPS, and avoid brews against Lych, which steals them. v57: Rubber to Gold now pays its bonus cash immediately when a bloon pops.

routes.name: Stronger Stimulant
routes.note: Middle crosspath raises the buff to 55 shots and 13 seconds, which matters most on fast-attacking towers.

routes.name: Berserker Brew
routes.note: Applies brews 1.25× as often: the better pick for slow-attacking towers.

routes.name: Permanent Brew
routes.note: Crosspath doesn't matter. The only way to fully buff very fast towers such as Sun Avatar; expensive for CHIMPS.

chimps: Stronger Stimulant at 4-2-0; Berserker Brew at 3-0-1 for slow-attacking towers.
Lower tiers are usually preferred in CHIMPS because Permanent Brew is expensive.
Avoid Rubber to Gold and Bloon Master Alchemist in CHIMPS.
boss: Rubber to Gold is boss-event income (v57: pays out instantly).
Never rely on brews against Lych: it steals them.

synergies.note: Bloonjitsu gains the most from Berserker Brew.
Overdrive gains the most from Berserker Brew.
Permanent Brew keeps Sun Avatar fully buffed.

name: Druid
summary: Avatar of Wrath with five Poplust druids and Stronger Stimulant is a CHIMPS win condition. Jungle's Bounty and Spirit of the Forest help keep lives up. The storm tier 5 is now called Monarch of Storms.

routes.name: Avatar of Wrath
routes.note: CHIMPS win condition with 5 Poplusts and Stronger Stimulant; too compact against Lych.

routes.name: Poplust
routes.note: The support druids that feed Avatar of Wrath.

routes.name: Jungle's Bounty
routes.note: Lives and cash ability; useful against Lych's life drain in boss events.

chimps: Avatar of Wrath (0-1-5) with five Poplust druids and Stronger Stimulant is a win condition.
boss: Jungle's Bounty and Spirit of the Forest help with lives against Lych.
Avatar of Wrath setups are too compact for Lych.

synergies.note: Stronger Stimulant and Permanent Brew on Poplust druids.
Buffs Magic Monkeys.

name: Mermonkey
summary: Amphibious Magic tower (35% more range in water). The top path's Abyssal creature adds pierce to nearby Monkeys. Tier 5s: Lord of the Abyss, Popseidon and The Final Harmonic.

routes.name: Abyss Dweller
routes.note: Listed as a CHIMPS support pick for its pierce boost to nearby towers.

routes.name: Popseidon
routes.note: Freezing tridents and an ice-ball ability; Silas lengthens its freeze.

routes.name: The Final Harmonic
routes.note: Hypnosis and detonation damage; the bottom path supports heroes and Magic Monkeys.

chimps: Abyss Dweller (3-0-1) is a support pick: its creature adds pierce to nearby towers.
35% more range in water; stack Echosense Network for more.
boss: Popseidon's freeze lasts longer with Silas.

synergies.note: Lengthens Popseidon's freeze.
The bottom path supports heroes and Magic Monkeys.

name: Skywarden
summary: Magic archer added in v56 and rebalanced in v57. Path 1 (Aerial Attunement → Zephyr Sense → Wind Weaver → Gale Sage → Farwind Seer) buffs range and gains camo at tier 2; path 2 ends in Stormwrath Archon; path 3 (Coldchain → Frozen Verdict → Winter's Mercy) cools Blastapopoulos and was strongly buffed against blimps.

routes.name: Farwind Seer
routes.note: Arrows hit harder the farther they fly. v57 made Wind Weaver and Gale Sage cheaper but cut Aerial Attunement's stacks to 3. Crosspath consensus is still forming.

routes.name: Stormwrath Archon
routes.note: v57: Thundering Arc now deals Plasma damage with a bigger blast; Thunder's Decree costs more and lasts less.

routes.name: Winter's Mercy
routes.note: v57 doubled its blimp damage (e.g. ZOMG 200 → 400) and it removes a lot of Blastapopoulos heat.

chimps: Too new for a CHIMPS consensus; Zephyr Sense (2-x-x) gives camo.
boss: Winter's Mercy path cools Blastapopoulos (v57 increased the heat reduction).

synergies.note: Another heat-reducing option against Blastapopoulos.

name: Banana Farm
summary: Earns nothing in CHIMPS. In boss events, Banana Research Facilities plus Overclock are the land economy core; Overclock raises a BRF from 5 to 9 crates per round.

routes.name: Banana Research Facility
routes.note: 5 crates of $390 per round with Valuable Bananas ($1,950); Banana Central (5-2-0) adds +25% to every BRF.

routes.name: Marketplace
routes.note: Auto-collects 16 packets per round; 2-0-3 is preferred while saving up. Good stepping stone to sell into BRFs.

routes.name: IMF Loan
routes.note: Bank → IMF Loan → Monkeyopolis ("Miniopolis") is the wiki's alternative early boss economy.

chimps: Earns nothing in CHIMPS.
boss: Rounds 1–20: two 2-0-0 farms, then Marketplaces or Bank → IMF Loan → Monkeyopolis.
Late: BRF spam with Overclock (5 → 9 crates), Banana Central for +25%.
Sell every farm at the end of round 119.

synergies.note: Overclock nearly doubles BRF crates.
Monkeyopolis absorbs farms for crates.
Early cash snowballs your farms.
Rare Quincy Action Figure and Fertilizer.

name: Spike Factory
summary: An excellent last line of defense placed at the end of the track. Perma-Spike is a CHIMPS win condition, and cheap base Spike Factories are common CHIMPS support. White Hot Spikes (tier 2 top) lets spikes pop leads, including DDTs.

routes.name: Perma-Spike
routes.note: CHIMPS win condition with Jungle Drums and a 3-0-1 Berserker Brew.

routes.name: Spike Storm
routes.note: Ability is strong against the R100 BAD; Carpet of Spikes (2-5-0) suits most non-dense rounds and bosses. v57 doubled Mini Spike bonus damage to MOABs.

routes.name: Super Mines
routes.note: Boss option against Dreadbloon from tier 2.

chimps: Perma-Spike (1-0-5) is a win condition with Jungle Drums and a 3-0-1 Berserker Brew.
Cheap 0-0-0 / 1-0-0 Spike Factories are common end-of-track support.
White Hot Spikes (tier 2 top) lets spikes pop leads, including DDTs.
boss: Spike Storm's ability handles the R100 BAD; Carpet of Spikes is good against bosses.
Mega Massive Munitions Factory is one of the highest-damage Paragons.

synergies.note: Jungle Drums is part of the Perma-Spike win condition.
3-0-1 Berserker Brew completes it.
Carpet of Spikes pairs with The Bloon Solver.

name: Monkey Village
summary: Jungle Drums is always recommended in CHIMPS, and the Monkey Intelligence Bureau lets nearby Monkeys pop every bloon type. Monkey City is to be avoided in CHIMPS.

routes.name: Monkey Intelligence Bureau
routes.note: Jungle Drums attack speed plus MIB damage coverage.

routes.name: Call to Arms
routes.note: Burst buff ability; Lych can steal it, so keep it away from Lych. v57: can no longer be re-activated while a Call to Arms or Homeland buff is already active.

routes.name: Monkeyopolis
routes.note: Boss-event economy: absorbs farms in its radius. Useless in CHIMPS.

chimps: Jungle Drums is always recommended; MIB covers every damage type.

boss: Call to Arms and Homeland Defense are stolen by Lych.
Monkeyopolis and Megaopolis drive late boss economy.

synergies.note: Perma-Spike needs Jungle Drums.

name: Engineer Monkey
summary: Overclock cuts a tower's attack cooldown by 40% (also boosts BRF and Banana Central output). Cleansing Foam removes camo and regrow. Don't overclock towers near Lych.

routes.name: Overclock
routes.note: The ability needs no crosspath; 0-4-2 adds pinning. Best on high-DPS towers, max-power beasts and BRFs.

routes.name: Ultraboost
routes.note: Permanent stacking boost; crosspaths add little for the cost.

routes.name: Bloon Trap
routes.note: Boss-event income; XXXL Trap is best at 0-2-5. v57: base cash from trapped pops is now paid immediately; only the bonus is stored.

routes.name: Sentry Champion
routes.note: The usual best crosspath for late-game MOAB and Fortified damage.

chimps: Cleansing Foam (0-3-0) removes camo and regrow.
Overclock your main carry (40% shorter attack cooldown).
boss: Overclock BRFs during farming; Bloon Trap (0-1-4) and XXXL Trap (0-2-5) for income.
Don't overclock towers near Lych.
Master Builder's Power Glove boosts other Paragons.

Max-power Orca or T-Rex are prime Overclock targets.
Good hero Overclock target.

name: Beast Handler
summary: The wiki calls Beast Handler top tier in CHIMPS because many upgrades fill unique niches. Beasts merge with same-path beasts of equal or higher tier to build Beast Power.

routes.name: Orca
routes.note: CHIMPS win condition set to Strong with Overclock; drags down MOABs and ZOMGs at max power.

routes.name: Megalodon
routes.note: Strong single-tower boss option (Bloonarius, Lych, Dreadbloon).

routes.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
routes.note: Stomp stuns ZOMG-class in a wide area; Giganotosaurus covers the whole map.

routes.name: Giant Condor
routes.note: Lifts smaller MOAB-class bloons; Pouākai can carry off almost anything.

chimps: The wiki rates Beast Handler top tier in CHIMPS.
Orca (4-0-0) on Strong targeting with Overclock is a win condition.
Merge beasts of the same path to build Beast Power.
boss: Megalodon (5-0-0) is a strong single-tower option against Bloonarius, Lych and Dreadbloon.

synergies.note: Overclock a max-power beast.
